entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, a self-hosted server, and a cloud platform.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes and supports hosted and local LLM providers.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files, with scoped semantic search across directories. It can archive sessions into inspectable Markdown memories and uses viking:// URIs with tiered L0/L1/L2 loading.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source memory platform that gives agents persistent long-term memory across sessions through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It structures text as entities, relationships, and searchable chunks, and supports custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API that extracts conversation facts, reconciles contradictions, and handles automatic forgetting. Its connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and it processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It shares memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, tracking peers, sessions, and messages over time. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports managed, local, and self-hosted use.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git-like repository, with version control for a context tree and five-tier retrieval, four tiers of which are non-LLM. It also offers a React/Ink TUI and REPL, plus support for 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes Agents with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search with structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It describes local infrastructure using Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and a Ground Truth hierarchy for prioritizing injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving context harness intended to help agents succeed on complex tasks. Runs can start from a plain-language goal or saved scenario, and their filesystem-based artifacts can be inspected, diffed, replayed, or exported.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches session histories already stored on disk across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, and other supported agents. It can also resume a session or continue it in another agent, and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes LCM is a Hermes Agent plugin that persists messages in SQLite using a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from that history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho Self-Hosted gives Hermes Agent private memory that persists across sessions. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: SignetAI provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer for agents including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Codex. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions and can run on a local machine or as a team server, with a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memories as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It offers local search with keyword search as a fallback, plus a CLI and MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can create session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, integrating through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term agent memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore, without requiring a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with Hermes Agent as well as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: YantrikDB is a self-maintaining memory plugin for Hermes with an embedded backend by default and an HTTP option. Its recall results include a why_retrieved explanation, and it also supports memory canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth for durable, cross-project memory, stored as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven memory CLI that maintains source-grounded knowledge across sessions as a Wiki with citations and history. It does not require embeddings or a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd is an anticipatory memory system that watches agent session logs to prefetch context. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under one memory owner for Hermes. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, then gives the agent a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal to retrieve connected information. It automatically indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags make stored notes navigable in both directions.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema token use through local keyword-based ranking. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, with integrations that remain opt-in rather than enabling automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file. Its importance-weighted recall brings higher-priority memories forward during context prefetch, alongside BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships between entries.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, and hooks into pre-LLM calls and session-end events.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes Agentmemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer. It supports immediate event deletion and records prefetch operations in a trace.jsonl audit log.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, helping restore it before work continues. It offers goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes, skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and uses no summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This Hermes plugin provides durable cross-session memory by communicating with XMemo over HTTPS. It supplies ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for searching and manually storing memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Sourcevault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, with slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes repository sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers retrieval through HNSW ANN, sparse search, and FM-index search, and can run via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory-management and knowledge-graph tools for Hermes Agent, with 17 tools for managing memories and traversing the graph. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit focuses on memory curation: it reviews plain Markdown files for stale or conflicting facts and proposes evidence-cited JSON diffs for review. A local Git repository tracks changes and lets you revert them, without using a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers combines an agentic skills framework with a software development workflow covering specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Its skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and its README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for creating and refining interactive web prototypes with a live preview, as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics. It supports coding-agent CLIs including Hermes Agent and includes skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3 frameworks. Its stated compatibility with over 26 AI platforms makes it a broad cybersecurity skills collection for agents.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and it offers the diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing audits and rewrites content to address detectable AI writing patterns; rewrite mode supports up to two editing passes. Its detector can score files or piped text, while in-place editing refuses source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw unifies skills across agents and devices, with integrations including Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. Its dashboard covers skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, and is compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-skills.io-compatible agents. It also maintains session state within the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This project offers professional agent skills with frameworks, output templates, quality checks, and anti-patterns, and states that its skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The README describes 21 skills designed for unattended use and installation via `npx pm-claude-skills add` or Claude Code's plugin directory.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube skills supports transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction across Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. The README says it requires a TranscriptAPI key and notes a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills. It can generate SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, and provides slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and scripts, including sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Helps agents work with literate programming by generating .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracting runnable files with a tangler. Source edits can also be synced back into the literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough project ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a review gate evaluates specs with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents centered on structured memory, cross-feature learning, and plan-approve-execute workflows. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, plus CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Supports shared memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. Its pipeline also supports fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides to installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. Contributions are submitted through pull requests, making it a community resource for Portuguese-speaking users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides official FLUX prompting skills for image and video generation, including a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills. It also includes BFL API integration for polling and webhooks.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills specification, and provides an npx command for installation. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse as agentskills.io-compliant skills. It offers automated and step-by-step workflows, with support for testing and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika describes a workflow language for AI, with workflows checked before a model is called and runs made with a model of your choice. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. Skill installation supports recursive dependency resolution, and the project also includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a way to recover safely.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script to validate credentials and configure access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills with one click. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and federates search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls to reduce token usage. Its five-layer retrieval combines hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion, with graceful degradation when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard is a read-only code review skill that searches for bugs without making fixes. Parallel subagents examine edge cases, adversarial concerns, and integration, while deterministic scans and proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox help verify findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system with daily-scored recurring habits and tasks for other activities. It runs locally with SQLite, includes an Android client, and connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This Hermes Agent skill uses Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness sub-agents to simplify code. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, and applies changes through risk tiers with an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings cybersecurity skills and tools together for Hermes Agent, with highlights listing 2,077 skills across multiple repositories and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes structures tasks into multiple stories and requires evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C# and .NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only dashboard for observing Hermes Agent activity, including token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It supports local log desensitization and optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown agent skills for code review and session management, among other workflows. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: Creates reproducible VHS tape or Playwright recording scripts to add demo GIFs to repository READMEs, with support for terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries. It also optimizes GIFs toward a target size under 8 MB, making it useful for projects that need compact, repeatable demos.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Builds Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift, helping skills stay aligned with current requirements.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: Searches a catalog of more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its CLI and MCP server work with clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Analyzes past sessions and installed skills to draft structured proposals for skill improvements, with proposals review-only by default. An evaluation gate can use deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators before changes are applied.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Provides skills for social data, web research, and enrichment, alongside packaged workflows that combine an agent, skills, and a data flow. It also welcomes community skills in its `skills/community/` directory.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Helps Hermes Agent route file operations using the path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. It also selects and verifies existing Python interpreters that are compatible with a project, without installing one.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers tools for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removing common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracting structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. These capabilities bring video, text, and document processing into Hermes skills.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: Lets agents find open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review; a human approves the winning answer before the wallet is paid. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.f-o-x11/deed-page-skill: Publishes files or folders to permanent deed.page URLs with one curl request and no account. The hosted MCP server supports updating, versioning, and deleting sites, and the project includes install instructions and manifests for multiple agents.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Tests skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers, then produces certificates signed with Ed25519. A public API supports certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools, along with five ready-to-use workflow skills. It also supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: AlphaPipeline checks tokens for honeypot, tax, and liquidity risks, and provides market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. Its REST endpoints and remote MCP server make it a fit for agents that need risk and market-data checks.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, with instructions for agents that read SKILL.md and installation guidance for several agent environments. It belongs on this list as an integration-focused skill rather than a market-data or analysis tool.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: China Briefing generates structured Chinese news reports at multiple geographic scales, from global to street level, with core conclusions and action suggestions. It also uses user interests via semantic memory to expand searches, making it suited to personalized news briefings.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project offers an astrology MCP server with deterministic results and SHA-256-verifiable hashes. Its no-auth MCP endpoint and per-call REST payment options via x402 or MPP distinguish it as an astrology service for agents.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that discovers server metadata and tool schemas incrementally, using three-layer loading to minimize token usage. Its socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct fit for Hermes Agent users who want MCP capabilities with lazy loading.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and automatically updates its packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` commands for the listed tools, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. It also documents OpenClaw setup and access to device hardware and UI through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct and CRD-based deployment workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image with mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This project provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation options via an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a deployment option with documented configuration examples and a Kubernetes install check.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local, pre-indexed project graph with `codegraph init` and auto-syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects the graph to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI for tracking token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. It also provides a visualization dashboard for analyzing usage, making it useful for comparing activity across clients.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor is a real-time widget for token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools. It reads Hermes Agent usage from its state database and includes historical trends and usage breakdowns.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance to help build interfaces with AI. It connects to coding tools through TypeUI MCP or plugins and supports AI providers that accept Markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop with seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for skins and themes for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files, and custom skins inherit unspecified values from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content, including configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows, with a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized around two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with a stated 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configuration and skills. It can switch between default and scoped agents, with project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes Agent. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco is a self-healing observability tool for AI agents, with a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time conversation telemetry. Its monitoring offers zero-token passive analysis or scheduled active probing, and uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with offline operation that requires no API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default, with explicit approval required for consequential actions and external writes. It includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local, open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. It includes 21 built-in professional assistants and supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent, with a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent that brings together chat, session management, agent integrations, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It also supports visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, or Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace combines chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector in a native web workspace. It also offers Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, or delegate across agents and queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This Hermes desktop workspace for Mac connects directly to local or SSH hosts and offers native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal provides direct shell access for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health-check and update capabilities, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted remote connections. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes Agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streaming chats and file or image attachments, and lets users browse, search, and resume sessions and view scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for token usage and latency, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring Hermes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and offers a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for sessions from Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It searches prompts, tool activity, errors, and file paths, tracks Codex and Claude quota use per session, and builds its search index locally.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted browser dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing together chat, a terminal, file browsing, session and cron management, system metrics, and agent status. It also provides MCP server lifecycle controls and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects to a local Hermes agent through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox lets users review requests with side effects before acting on them.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that connects to the Hermes Agent gateway. It combines tabs for profiles, sessions, skills, cron, and memory with kanban boards, task details, diagnostics, and dispatch controls.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its terminal chat supports streaming responses and file attachments, while background agent spawning supports up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages a Windows desktop GUI with session management, workflow automation, and runtime tool creation. It supports local models through LM Studio and is described as requiring no installation, Docker, or administrator rights.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted web interface for Hermes Agent with a glassmorphic chat view and real-time log streaming. It also includes a file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It also lets users inspect conversation histories and skill source code, and provides read-only monitoring of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It also includes a marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent collaboration, with streaming chat, model switching, and a PM orchestrator. It features collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents and a visual store with more than 50 curated one-click skill installations.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin lets users switch models across Hermes Agent Web Dashboard profiles from one matrix of configured routes. It previews changes before applying them and includes named presets and a guarded Undo.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent supports interactive answers such as checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It also provides command approvals and live tool-step updates, with builds for Android, web, and macOS and an alpha for Linux.
